reviews.title: Good Service but App Desperately needs a Revamp
reviews.text: Cab drives are always great, fast and efficient. BUT If you are only paying with cash then this is a great app. However ordering cabs with a card, it’s horrendous. It will say finding driver, then just cancel the cab. I have ordered and have had 6 rides cancelled within 15 minutes. It’s unpredictable when you’ll get a ride which makes it unreliable. I really wish they would fix this it has been like this for two years.
